text_block_list.text: The night before the Queen Elizabeth II Cup—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
That inner conflict itself
is likely your answer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you just
admit it honestly?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...'The full moon is beautiful.
Without a single flaw... a perfect shape.'"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"That's true.
And?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "...A long time ago, an Umamusume said something to me. Back then, I was struggling with how small-minded I was compared to the grand ideals I held."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That girl wanted to run, but couldn't. Yet she never gave up, and by literally risking life and limb, she had only just regained the ability to run.

text_block_list.name: Young Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "It's only natural to give your everything for what you want."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
“—For the sake of the happiness I seek,
I shall become an unblemished full moon.”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And so, I shall create the ideal world.
As proof of my resolve—I dedicate my very heart and soul.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I had thought that you... you of all people,
would understand this determination.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Giggle.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Loulou,
you poor beast.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
It seems you're all alone...
That's why you want to be pampered, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...No, I didn't mean that.
Let's get some sleep. I'll walk you to your room—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
How unfortunate.
I have no intention of understanding you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
However,
I can feel it for you if it's on the turf.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
If you truly call yourself the 'Emperor,'
you must not let me run free...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...That is, of course,
if you can catch me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: The moratorium is over.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Good night, Loulou.
Until tomorrow—let us meet again in Kyoto.

Dawn broke on the day of the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.
The first thing Mejiro Ramonu said
was that Symboli Rudolf was coming to watch.

Surprised, I asked if Mejiro Ramonu
had been the one to persuade them—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: No, that's not true.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Getting her to move is as simple as turning a faucet.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm being
pretty childish myself, aren't I?
“—Having finished all preparations, on the way to the track...”

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text: —Lady Ramonu!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
choice_data_list: (That girl, I'm pretty sure she was in the Oaks too...)

text_block_list.text:
That's the Umamusume who declared war on Mejiro Ramonu.
Back then, she seemed somewhat fearful... but now, she wears a clear and determined look.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
"...Um.
I'm looking forward to today!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
I... looked up to you. But gradually,
I began to wonder why we were so different—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
I felt jealous, too.
But feelings like that... were completely meaningless.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
"You were just far away, so far away...
I thought about giving up."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
"Still! No matter what I do,
I can't help looking up to you...!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
"...Lining up in the same gate,
there's no way I'm just going to admire them from afar."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
—I'll make them turn around.
I'll make sure they know... I'm right behind them!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
"M-Me too...!
—I won't back down either...!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
It was my admiration for you
that brought me all the way here...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
The ones Ms. Ramonu should be looking at
are us!!
One by one, the Umamusume raise their voices. Adoring Mejiro Ramonu, envying her... yet refusing to give up, they are about to challenge her once again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: *Haa*, thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I was worried that
I might have broken the delicate flowers.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
You are all truly adorable...
Are you done nibbling on me now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Go ahead,
I'll keep you company..."

âIn that instant, the atmosphere turned deadly.
Brimming with fighting spirit, the Umamusume headed toward the track...
"To bring about the supreme race, she incites both the audience and the runners, and is even attempting to add the 'Emperor' into the equation."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You're getting ahead of yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I will become one from now on.
Right?"
